title: Time Series and Sequence Prediction
description: Stationarity, ARIMA, windowing techniques, 1D CNNs, LSTMs for forecasting, multi-step prediction, and anomaly detection.
objectives: Understand time series fundamentals and stationarity
Build 1D CNN and LSTM forecasting models
Detect anomalies in time series data
keyTakeaways: Stationarity = constant mean/variance over time; difference or log-transform non-stationary series before modeling
Windowing: slide a fixed-length input window and predict the next N steps — the key data-prep step for all DL forecasting
1D CNNs capture local temporal patterns efficiently; stack with dilation for longer receptive fields without more parameters
LSTM encoder-decoder for multi-step forecasting: encoder summarizes the past, decoder auto-regressively generates future steps
Reconstruction error from an autoencoder trained on normal data is a principled anomaly score for time series
